scenario: LSIG.1.2 / 1.3.3 CC-5: `active_fraction` on a `Float` slot is a compile error — it is admitted on `Bool` only.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    val: Float mutable

series Sensor.val:
    active_fraction sliding 5_min

rule r:
    Sensor
->
    log info "x"
